statement: DATO (abstract level): other GSK-3 inhibitors: anticonvulsant in several provoked models, worse or opposite in others (status epilepticus worsened in one study; higher GSK-3 activity slowed kainate epileptogenesis in another); none in a Wwox model; tideglusib has no seizure-model result.

DATO (label and abstract level): lithium paediatric label from age 7 (bipolar), not established below 7 years; toxicity close to therapeutic concentrations; infant data are breast-milk exposure case reports only.

DATO (abstract level): GSK-3 inhibition and myelination: raised oligodendrocyte differentiation in some studies and suppressed it in others; conditional beta-catenin activation delayed developmental myelination; the sign is stage-dependent.
